using Xunit;
using Moq;
using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common;
using OpenRA.Support;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
	public class WebServicesTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public void CheckModVersion_SetsLatest_WhenResponseIsEmptyString()
		{
			var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			mockClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Content = new StringContent("")
				});

			var mockFactory = new Mock<HttpClientFactory>();
			mockFactory.Setup(f => f.Create()).Returns(mockClient.Object);

			// Replace HttpClientFactory static in test scope
			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockClient.Object;

			try
			{
				var webServices = new WebServices();
				webServices.CheckModVersion();

				// Give async task time to complete
				Thread.Sleep(100);

				Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.Latest, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public void CheckModVersion_SetsOutdated_WhenResponseIsOutdated()
		{
			TestResponseSetsStatus("outdated", ModVersionStatus.Outdated);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void CheckModVersion_SetsUnknown_WhenResponseIsUnknown()
		{
			TestResponseSetsStatus("unknown", ModVersionStatus.Unknown);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void CheckModVersion_SetsPlaytestAvailable_WhenResponseIsPlaytest()
		{
			TestResponseSetsStatus("playtest", ModVersionStatus.PlaytestAvailable);
		}

		private void TestResponseSetsStatus(string response, ModVersionStatus expectedStatus)
		{
			var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			mockClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Content = new StringContent(response)
				});

			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockClient.Object;

			try
			{
				var webServices = new WebServices();
				webServices.CheckModVersion();

				Thread.Sleep(100);

				Assert.Equal(expectedStatus, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public void CheckModVersion_HandlesHttpException_Silently()
		{
			var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			mockClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
				.ThrowsAsync(new HttpRequestException());

			var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
			HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockClient.Object;

			try
			{
				var webServices = new WebServices();
				webServices.CheckModVersion();

				Thread.Sleep(100);

				// Should not throw and status should remain default (NotChecked)
				Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.NotChecked, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
			}
			finally
			{
				HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
			}
		}
	}
}

using Xunit;
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common;
using OpenRA.Support;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
	public class WebServicesTests
	{
		private readonly WebServices webServices;

		public WebServicesTests()
		{
			webServices = new WebServices();
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsLatest_WhenResponseIsEmptyOrLatest()
		{
			await TestResponseAsync("", ModVersionStatus.Latest);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsOutdated_WhenResponseIsOutdated()
		{
			await TestResponseAsync("outdated", ModVersionStatus.Outdated);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsUnknown_WhenResponseIsUnknown()
		{
			await TestResponseAsync("unknown", ModVersionStatus.Unknown);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsPlaytestAvailable_WhenResponseIsPlaytest()
		{
			await TestResponseAsync("playtest", ModVersionStatus.PlaytestAvailable);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task CheckModVersion_KeepsNotChecked_OnException()
		{
			using var listener = HttpListener.Create();
			listener.Prefixes.Add("http://localhost/");
			listener.Start();

			try
			{
				webServices.CheckModVersion();
				await Task.Delay(200); // Allow async task to run

				Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.NotChecked, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
			}
			finally
			{
				listener.Stop();
			}
		}

		private async Task TestResponseAsync(string responseBody, ModVersionStatus expectedStatus)
		{
			var testServer = CreateTestHttpServer(responseBody);
			try
			{
				// Replace HttpClientFactory static in test scope
				var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
				HttpClientFactory.Create = () => new HttpClient(testServer);

				try
				{
					webServices.ModVersionStatus = ModVersionStatus.NotChecked;
					webServices.CheckModVersion();
					await Task.Delay(200); // Allow async task to complete

					Assert.Equal(expectedStatus, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
				}
				finally
				{
					HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				testServer.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private HttpMessageHandler CreateTestHttpServer(string responseBody)
		{
			return new DelegatingHandler
			{
				InnerHandler = new HttpMessageHandlerStub(responseBody)
			};
		}

		private class HttpMessageHandlerStub : HttpMessageHandler
		{
			private readonly string responseBody;

			public HttpMessageHandlerStub(string responseBody)
			{
				this.responseBody = responseBody;
			}

			protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
			{
				return Task.FromResult(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Content = new StringContent(responseBody)
				});
			}
		}

		private class DelegatingHandler : DelegatingHandler
		{
			protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
			{
				return base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
			}
		}
	}
}
